frame_index_space: families.rider.frames; verify frame_ids and source before integration

playback_rule.when_blocked: hold idle rather than advancing gait

observed_pose_order: fore reach with hind leg trailing
lower fore recovery and hind passing
hind recovery raised with alternate fore support
hind settles while fore reaches, returns to first pose
selection_reason: Use the first four v8 poses as a short whole-sprite loop. They retain similar upper-body silhouette and provide clearer low-leg changes than v5. Omit the second row, which mostly reintroduces forward-fore variants and an elevated recovery rather than completing a trustworthy eight-phase progression.

alternatives_inspected.v5: Native atlas examined: repeated near-fore silhouettes make eight-frame playback read held for too long.
alternatives_inspected.v6: Source plus native-scale extraction examined: conspicuous bent foreleg lift gives prancing rather than low walking. Not in current admitted catalog.
alternatives_inspected.v8: Native atlas and full source examined; first-row subset selected.

uncertainty: Stride12pixels is an initial visual calibration estimate, not a measured planted-hoof displacement: generated occlusions prevent reliable foot identity tracking. Plausible tuning range8–16pixels per cycle.
This four-pose subset improves readability; it does not prove anatomical four-beat locomotion or eliminate foot sliding. Inspect actual travel at18,24,32pixels per second before admission.
Durations are seconds per frame at speed_scale1. Actor configuration converts seconds to SpriteFrames weights by multiplying fps; do not apply this conversion twice.
Use actual post-collision travel speed. A prior72px/s animation reference would under-animate this slow12px stride.
